subject: Hold demo environment — request temporary token grant while finance verifies PO
messages:
From: Claire Barnes <claire@mediview.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot continuity while PO is in finance queue

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from our side — we're excited to keep the pilot active but finance is still validating the PO. Procurement has the PO and told us it will be another 4-6 business days before it's processed (they flagged additional vendor onboarding checks). We don't want the team to lose momentum.

Could Redwood provide a short token top-up or temporary access to keep the sandbox + demo environment live until our PO clears? We're requesting a 10k token buffer (roughly 3 days of current usage) so our engineers can finish the integration tests.

PO reference (pending): MVW-2027-089
Estimated PO approval: 2027-08-13

I've attached the PO intent and a short note from our finance lead to confirm this is in-flight. Happy to loop in procurement or share any additional verification needed.

Thanks,
Claire Barnes
Director, Platform Integrations
Mediview
Attachment: mediview_po_intent.pdf (pdf)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@mediview.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity while PO is in finance queue

Claire — thanks for the details and for attaching the intent doc. We can absolutely keep the pilot live while Mediview's PO is clearing.

Proposed short-term support:
- Grant a 10k token buffer to your sandbox account today (good for 5 calendar days).
- If PO arrives before the buffer is exhausted, we'll apply charges to the PO retroactively.
- If PO does not arrive within 5 days, we'll touch base before suspending any access.

Two requests from our side:
1) Can you share the expected approver (name/email) at finance so we can flag the vendor check if needed?
2) Please confirm the PO number and final billing contact once available.

I'm CCing Marcus and Karthik for internal visibility — Marcus, can you approve the temporary token grant from the pilot reserve? If you want me to submit a one-off credit approval form, I can do that now.

Claire, if that works I can provision the buffer this afternoon and reply with the token allotment and expiry.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Thanks, Vanessa — that plan sounds perfect. Approver in finance is Tom Huang (tom.huang@mediview.ai). He confirmed internally that the PO is being prioritized and that 2027-08-13 is the earliest likely processing date.

Confirming PO number as soon as procurement publishes the final one; we'll send the billing contact (Elena Park) in the next update.

I've attached a revised PO draft that shows the correct line items (we expect the official PO to match this).

Appreciate you moving quickly on this.

—Claire
